decision_steps: Record each of the three facts with its source.
If agreement is missing and expectation differs from the report scope, set evidence state to 'scope unconfirmed'.
Also release one neutral scope-clarification question.
Record who set each limit and what led to it, from the client's answers, so the file shows the whole picture.

note: Removed the step that held back completeness questions in a disputed scope (E11: limits silence nothing). Added recording who set each limit and what led to it (E21).
